description: This header defines the interface for a filesystem monitor listener component specific to a backend in the fsmonitor system. It declares initialization, cleanup, event loop, and shutdown functions for the listener thread, which are meant to be implemented per platform/backend.

methods.name: fsm_listen__ctor
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific data for the fsmonitor listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__dtor
methods.description: Cleans up platform-specific data for the fsmonitor listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__loop
methods.description: Contains the main event loop monitoring filesystem events for the listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__stop_async
methods.description: Requests the listener thread to shutdown gracefully without waiting for it to stop.
